summary: Surveyed all 334 listed .lean files (QuantumAlg/Analysis and QuantumAlg/Util, 244 B to 379 KB). A line-start declaration grep (theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/inductive/abbrev/example/axiom/opaque, with modifiers) found declarations in 312 files. The 22 files with zero declarations are 21 module aggregators (public imports plus module docstrings, some with namespace/open) and one tactic-macro file; aggregators stay primary-eligible under FILTER-007 because no auxiliary delivery channel is verified, and the macro file defines proof automation. The largest files (Interval/Witness.lean, RSA/ShortLog/Reduction.lean, Laurent/Witness.lean) are hand-written proof developments, not generated data. No file meets the FILTER-002/FILTER-004 bar, so every file is retained.
